column2: Encouraging Active Play
In Romania, Intel volunteers received an Intel Involved
Matching Seed Grant to transform an empty space
in a small village near Bucharest into an area for
indoor sports. The “mini-gym” will give students
at an adjacent school a place for active play during
the long winter months.
Teaching Management Skills
To help young people acquire theskills needed to lead
efforts to overcome challenges in developing countries,
an Intel Involved Hero Award finalist designed curricula
and recruited other volunteers to help him teach project
management skills at public schools in Costa Rica.
Organizing for Autism
An Intel Involved Hero Award finalist in Dalian,
China has led multiple efforts to assist people in her
community affected by autism. She has donated more
than 1,000 hours of her time to raise funds and lead
other volunteers in helping people with autism develop
their artistic potential.
